card.name: Words after a subject or section number
card.fires_on: Short function or heading words that follow a subject or a section number, such as 'should' after 'Physicians', 'Important' or 'Laboratory' after a section number like 2.2 or 7.3, and 'official' or 'to' in running text.

modes.label: Physicians should
modes.description: The word 'should' or 'physicians' in a sentence advising physicians or patients.
modes.example: Physicians<< should>> inform patients of the risk of malignancy

modes.label: Section heading start
modes.description: First word of a numbered section heading or table caption in a drug label.

modes.label: General web text
modes.description: A linking word such as 'to', 'for' or 'official' in ordinary prose.
modes.example: new company was authorized<< to>> own and control all the rights and properties

card.plain: It fires on small words that come right after a subject or a section number, mostly in drug labels.
